assay: bulk total-RNA RNA-seq of vastus lateralis muscle (S3.10.2.p1, S1.4.p1)
design: two parallel arms (concurrent trials NCT02706288 / NCT02706262), each sampled Before and After ~10% weight loss; Diet+EX (calorie restriction + multi-modal exercise) vs Diet-ONLY (calorie restriction alone) (S3.1.p1)
sample_inclusion: RNA-seq on Diet-ONLY n=6 and Diet+EX n=7 (one Diet+EX sample excluded for poor RNA quality) (FIG8, S3.10.2.p1)
primary_estimand: Within-arm change in muscle gene expression After vs Before weight loss, in Diet+EX (the exercise-containing arm) and in Diet-ONLY; the exercise contribution is read as the difference between the two arms' responses (S1.4.p1, S3.13.2.1.p1). The paper tested the between-arm difference only for selected genes by ANCOVA (FIG8).
planned_contrasts: Diet+EX After vs Before (S1.4.p1; paper: 877 DEGs, 623 up / 254 down)
Diet-ONLY After vs Before (S1.4.p1; paper: 1 DEG, HMOX1 down)
paper_method: edgeR 3.40.2, Before vs After within each group (S3.13.2.1.p1); expression presented as log2 CPM (S3.10.2.p1)
paper_results: 877 DEGs in Diet+EX (623 up, 254 down), 1 DEG in Diet-ONLY (HMOX1 down); upregulated DEGs enriched for mitochondrial energy metabolism and angiogenesis GO-BP terms (DAVID, FDR<0.01); key genes PPARGC1A, MFF, CS, MDH1, CYCS, ATP5F1A, ACADVL, ACADM, LPL, CD36, VEGFA, KDR increased more in Diet+EX (S1.4.p1, FIG8)
